title: CHAOS PHYSICS! | Copi Cafe Episode 48 | Cornucopias
description:
In this short episode of Copi Cafe, Josh kicks the discussion off talking about creating a hybrid marketplace for the Cornucopias Metaverse. Rob then goes on to talk in depth about testing plans for the game and strategy for onboarding test groups. The guys then answer some more pressing community questions on Discord. Finally, they then move on to a new exciting leak!

Our original specs stated 60gb as we read them off, but officially we feel that 100gb is more realistic.

03:07 Marketplace NFTs
07:53 Tree Chopping
10:19 Testing
13:57 Q1 ACHIEVEMENTS
14:51 BEWARE OF SCAMS
18:37 Community Questions
23:50 Leaks!
